items.headline: AD David Harris slams Tulane's 'unacceptable' effort in 50-point loss
items.description: Tulane athletic director David Harris says he was "embarrassed" by what he called an "alarming" 50-point loss to Tulsa on homecoming weekend.

items.headline: Baylor Hayes to Oran Singleton Jr. connection lights it up for Tulsa in 60-10 rout of Tulane
items.description: — Baylor Hayes threw a career-high four touchdown passes, three of them to Oran Singleton Jr., and Tulsa ruined Tulane's homecoming game with a 60-10 drubbing of the Green Wave on Saturday.
